name: Forgotten Pool
summary: Beyond the Moonshrine Ruins, Forgotten Pool lies beneath Blackfathom Deeps. Monstrous deep-sea predators haunt its dark waters.

sections.title: A Submerged Lair
sections.body:
Dive through the sunken waterways beyond the Moonshrine Ruins to reach Forgotten Pool. Dark water fills this isolated cavern, cut off from dry ground.

Nearby, Twilight's Hammer cultists chant and naga patrol the flooded halls. The pool lies apart from them. Old Serra'kis, an ancient aquatic terror, lairs hidden in its depths.

faq.q: Where is the Forgotten Pool located?
faq.answer: Forgotten Pool lies deep within Blackfathom Deeps, beyond the Moonshrine Ruins. Swim through flooded tunnels to reach the submerged cavern.

faq.q: What lurks inside the Forgotten Pool?
faq.answer: Old Serra'kis, an ancient thresher-like beast, lurks in Forgotten Pool. The secluded cavern is its lair.

faq.q: Does the Forgotten Pool lead anywhere else?
aliases: is forgotten pool a dead end
faq.answer: No. Forgotten Pool is an underwater dead end with no further passageways. It is a secluded aquatic nest.

angles.text: As a Horde scout in Blackfathom Deeps, you may find Old Serra'kis lurking in Forgotten Pool, far from the cult's chanting halls.
